result.instructions: Tools for Demio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What webinars do we have coming up, and when do they start?"; "Who attended our last session of the onboarding webinar, and who left early?"; "Register jane@example.com for the product demo webinar.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Demio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run demio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run demio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run demio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. demio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: demio_check_connection
tools.title: Check connection
tools.description: Check that the API key and secret are valid. Returns pong=true and whether the key pair is a sandbox pair. Demio API: GET /ping.

tools.name: demio_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List active (not canceled) webinar events with their next session, status, time and registration URL. Use type=upcoming for future sessions, past for finished ones, or automated for evergreen events. Demio API: GET /events.

type.description: Filter by event type. Omit for all active events.

tools.name: demio_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: Get one event with its registration URL, next session ID and every session (date) in its series, with status and time. Demio API: GET /event/{id}.

active.description: Return only the active sessions in the series.

tools.name: demio_get_event_session
tools.title: Get event session
tools.description: Get one session (event date) with its status, Unix timestamp and time zone. Demio API: GET /event/{id}/date/{date_id}.

date_id.description: Session ID, also called Event Date ID (from demio_get_event).

tools.name: demio_list_participants
tools.title: List session participants
tools.description: List the participants of one session with their name, email, custom field values, attendance flag and status. Use status to filter (attended, did not attend, completed, left early, banned). Demio API: GET /report/{date_id}/participants.

date_id.description: Session ID, also called Event Date ID (from demio_get_event).

status.description: Only return participants with this status.

tools.name: demio_register_attendee
tools.title: Register attendee
tools.description: WRITE: register one person for a webinar and return their personal join link. Give event_id or ref_url. Without date_id, Demio uses the nearest active session. A repeat call can create a second registrant. Demio API: PUT /event/register.

event_id.description: Event ID. Give this or ref_url.

ref_url.description: Event registration page URL, when the event ID is unknown.

date_id.description: Session ID. Omit to use the nearest active session.

gdpr.description: Value for the predefined GDPR field.

custom_fields.description: Custom registration fields as { field_id: value }. Field IDs are in the event's Registration block.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Demio
prompts.description: What you can do with Demio here, with example requests to try.
